title: OpenBao Quickstart: Seal, Unseal, and What Delete Really Means
description: Deploy OpenBao on Kubernetes, initialize it and watch a sealed instance refuse to serve, unseal it with Shamir key shares, then write a secret, version it, and find out which of delete and destroy you can undo.

steps.title: Deploy OpenBao, and meet a pod that is not Ready
Initialize and unseal with Shamir key shares
Write a secret, then rotate it and read the old one back
Delete you can undo, destroy you cannot
